nhsAndPrivate: Kennet Bridge Dental is a mixed practice. Most routine care — check-ups, fillings, extractions — is available on the NHS. We also offer private treatment where you want more choice: in materials, in appointment times, or in treatments the NHS does not fund, such as aligners, implants or whitening. We tell you which category every treatment falls into, and what it costs, before you agree to anything.

outOfHoursCopy: When the practice is closed, call NHS 111. They can advise you and, if you need to be seen, direct you to the local urgent dental service. For a genuine emergency — uncontrolled bleeding, or swelling that affects your breathing or swallowing — go straight to A&E.
